requirements.display_name: Replacement cabin air filter specified for the vehicle

actions.title: Open the glove box and remove the support rod
actions.instruction: Open the glove box and remove the support rod from the glove box.

actions.title: Release the glove-box stopper pins
actions.instruction: Push in both sides of the glove box so the stopper pins release and the glove box can hang down.

actions.title: Press the cabin-filter cover lock
actions.instruction: Press and hold the lock on the right side of the cabin-air-filter cover.

actions.title: Remove the cabin-filter cover
actions.instruction: Pull the cabin-air-filter cover out while the right-side lock is released.

actions.title: Replace the cabin air filter
actions.instruction: Remove the old cabin air filter and install the replacement filter with its arrow symbol facing downward.

actions.title: Reassemble the glove box
actions.instruction: Reassemble the cabin-filter cover, glove-box stopper arrangement, and support rod in the reverse order of disassembly.
